prompt.project_info: Create a cinematic rainy-night taxi ride candid photograph.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult sophisticated Gen-Z woman with loose messy hair, natural glowing skin, sleepy reflective gaze, wearing an opaque knee-length dark dress, oversized thrifted blazer, and layered silver necklaces, holding a vintage flip phone or compact camera.
prompt.composition_elements: Curled comfortably in the back seat with legs naturally arranged, head near rain-streaked window, dark leather interior, neon city signs rendered as colorful bokeh, dashboard clock reading 02:44, and no sexualized framing.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Harsh smartphone flash against exterior neon bokeh, cold street light on hair, realistic raindrop reflections, high ISO texture, intimate melancholic expensive night mood.
prompt.technical_specs: 9:16 smartphone rear-camera photograph, high ISO, raw processing, shallow depth of field, motion blur on city background, realistic digital noise.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A cinematic 9:16 taxi-ride photograph of an approved adult woman during a rainy night. She has loose messy hair, natural glowing skin, and a sleepy reflective gaze while wearing an opaque dark knee-length dress, oversized thrifted blazer, and layered silver necklaces. She curls comfortably in the back seat with her head near a rain-streaked window, holding a vintage flip phone or compact camera. The dark leather interior has realistic stitching and wear; neon city signs blur into colorful bokeh, and a dashboard clock reads 02:44. Use harsh phone flash, cold street light on the hair, raindrop reflections, high ISO, raw processing, motion blur in the background, and realistic digital noise.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, lace slip dress, cleavage, alluring parted lips, sexualized curled pose, nudity, readable logos, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, public figure likeness.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required environment reference.
